title: Founding reference packages and pin verification

claims.text: reference_get returns the lineage.reference/v1 descriptor with gold rules for gold_s1 or the memory document for memory_v21, never exposing other package contents.
reference_verify and verify check the package digest against an optional expected sha256 and report verified true with the checked file list.
require_pins requires exactly the two public reference ids sorted by id, validates their hashes, and raises hash_mismatch through _fail when any pin is missing, extra or unverifiable.
_package and _inventory confine reads to the references tree with descriptor-relative descriptors, and get returns only id, sha256, byte counts and rule id-section-text triples.

triggers: pin verification fails at agent creation

decision.rule: Change here when reference package reading, pin verification or the public reference inventory needs to change.
decision.failure: An agent is created without verified founding pins, a digest mismatch passes silently, or a package read escapes the references tree.

questions.q: Where does require_pins verify both founding reference pins?
Where should I check why reference_verify reports a hash mismatch?
Where can I debug a failure reading a reference package file?
